mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.room_number, r.room_type, r.capacity, r.version AS room_version, r.state_version, f.floor_number, b.building_name FROM room r JOIN dormitory_floor f ON f.id = r.floor_id JOIN dormitory_building b ON b.id = f.building_id WHERE r.id = #{roomId}

SELECT bed.id, bed.bed_code, bed.bed_type, bed.position_index, bed.bed_frame_id, bed.operational_status, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM bed_assignment assignment WHERE assignment.bed_id = bed.id AND assignment.assignment_status = 'ACTIVE' ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM room_assignment residency WHERE residency.bed_id = bed.id AND residency.assignment_status = 'ACTIVE' ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS occupied, layout.layout_x, layout.layout_z, layout.rotation_degrees, CASE WHEN layout.bed_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS custom_layout FROM bed LEFT JOIN room_bed_layout layout ON layout.bed_id = bed.id WHERE bed.room_id = #{roomId} AND bed.operational_status <> 'RETIRED' ORDER BY bed.position_index, bed.id
SELECT id, version, state_version, capacity FROM room WHERE id = #{roomId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT bed.id, bed.bed_code, bed.bed_type, bed.position_index, bed.bed_frame_id, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM bed_assignment assignment WHERE assignment.bed_id = bed.id AND assignment.assignment_status = 'ACTIVE' ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM room_assignment residency WHERE residency.bed_id = bed.id AND residency.assignment_status = 'ACTIVE' ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS occupied FROM bed WHERE bed.room_id = #{roomId} AND bed.operational_status <> 'RETIRED' ORDER BY bed.position_index, bed.id FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE room SET room_type = #{roomType}, capacity = #{capacity}, version = version + 1, state_version = state_version + 1 WHERE id = #{roomId} AND version = #{expectedVersion}
UPDATE bed SET bed_type = #{bedType}, bed_frame_id = NULL, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{bedId}
UPDATE bed SET bed_frame_id = NULL, operational_status = 'RETIRED', version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{bedId} AND room_id = #{roomId} AND operational_status <> 'RETIRED'
UPDATE bed SET bed_frame_id = NULL, bed_type = #{bedType}, operational_status = 'ENABLED', version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{bedId} AND room_id = #{roomId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bed_frame (room_id, frame_code, frame_type, enabled) VALUES (#{roomId}, #{frameCode}, 'BUNK_FRAME', 1)
mapper.update: UPDATE bed SET bed_frame_id = #{frameId}, bed_type = 'BUNK_UPPER', version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{bedId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bed (room_id, bed_frame_id, bed_code, bed_type, position_index, operational_status) VALUES (#{roomId}, #{frameId}, #{bedCode}, 'BUNK_LOWER', #{positionIndex}, 'ENABLED')

INSERT INTO room_bed_layout (bed_id, layout_x, layout_z, rotation_degrees, updated_by) VALUES
(#{item.bedId}, #{item.layoutX}, #{item.layoutZ}, #{item.rotation}, #{item.updatedBy})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE layout_x = VALUES(layout_x), layout_z = VALUES(layout_z), rotation_degrees = VALUES(rotation_degrees), updated_by = VALUES(updated_by), version = version + 1
